title: SkillScriptBench: Benchmarking Self-Evolution of Executable Agent Skill Packages Beyond Markdown
title_zh: SkillScriptBench：超越 Markdown 的 executable Agent 技能包自演化基准测试

paragraphs.en: Executable Agent Skills combine natural-language instructions and scripts into reusable packages for LLM agents, and revising them requires fixing errors without breaking correct behavior. Existing benchmarks do not systematically distinguish documentation repair, script repair, and preservation when evaluating skill self-evolution. We introduce SkillScriptBench, a 350-task benchmark designed to evaluate these capabilities separately. From a survey of over 35,000 GitHub-hosted Skill roots, we select 100 packages and construct 150 repair tasks. Each task pairs a package containing injected script faults with a maintenance request and executable checks of the required behavior. A complementary controlled track contains 200 tasks from 50 packages, each evaluated under the same maintenance request in four states: clean, documentation faults, script faults, and faults in both. Across four LLMs, methods that edit both documentation and scripts can repair script faults but do not consistently outperform Markdown-only revision on documentation repair or preservation. We therefore introduce AST-Guided Skill Revision, which uses abstract syntax trees and calling relationships to link maintenance requirements to relevant code locations. It restricts script edits to these locations and updates the documentation to match the revised scripts. Averaged across models, this revision stage yields absolute gains in repair success of 21.9% for Raw Package and 27.7% for CoEvoSkills on faulty packages. Absolute gains in the proportion of tasks solved in all three runs reach 20.8% and 31.5%, respectively, indicating more consistent repair success across repeated runs.
paragraphs.zh: 可执行智能体技能将自然语言指令和脚本结合成可重用的软件包，供大型语言模型智能体使用；而修订这些技能时，需要在不破坏正确行为的前提下修复错误。 现有的基准测试在评估技能的自我演化能力时，并未系统地区分文档修复、脚本修复与功能保留这三个方面。 我们提出了 SkillScriptBench——一个包含 350 个任务的基准测试，旨在分别评估上述各项能力。 通过对 GitHub 上超过 35,000 个 Skill 根目录的调研，我们筛选出 100 个软件包，并构建了 150 个修复任务。 每个任务都包含一个注入了脚本错误的软件包、一份维护请求，以及对所需行为的可执行验证测试。 一个补充的受控测试轨道包含来自 50 个软件包的 200 个任务，每个任务均在相同的维护请求下，于四种状态进行评估：无错误、文档存在错误、脚本存在错误，以及文档和脚本均存在错误。 在四款大型语言模型中，同时编辑文档和脚本的方法虽然能够修复脚本错误，但在文档修复或功能保留方面，其表现并未始终优于仅使用 Markdown 的修订方法。 因此，我们提出了基于抽象语法树的技能修订方法（AST-Guided Skill Revision），该方法利用抽象语法树和调用关系，将维护需求与相关的代码位置关联起来。 该方法将脚本编辑限制在这些关联位置，并同步更新文档以匹配修订后的脚本。 跨模型平均来看，在存在错误的软件包中，这一修订阶段使原始软件包（Raw Package）的修复成功率提升了 21.9%，CoEvoSkills 的修复成功率提升了 27.7%。 在所有三次运行中成功完成任务的比例绝对增益分别达到了 20.8% 和 31.5%，表明该方法在重复运行中的修复成功率更加稳定。

paragraphs.en: LLM agents increasingly perform multi-step tasks through sustained interaction with tools, files, and execution environments ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . Reliable execution depends on procedural knowledge for coordinating operations, recovering from failures, and validating outputs ( Wang et al., 2023 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) . Agent Skills make this knowledge reusable by organizing instructions in a SKILL.md file, optionally accompanied by executable scripts and supporting resources ( Agent Skills, 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . These packages provide workflows that agents can reuse across tasks, while skill self-evolution uses experience and feedback to revise them as requirements change or failures emerge ( Zhong et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Liu et al., 2026a ; Liu et al., 2026b ) . For executable skills, this process involves both the documented workflow and its implementation, making consistency between documentation and scripts an important part of reliable evolution.

paragraphs.en: Existing research spans three settings: evaluating the downstream utility of fixed skills, generating reusable skills from task experience or source corpora, and refining existing skills through feedback. Fixed-skill benchmarks assess packages without revising them, while representative skill-generation and continual-learning benchmarks often use a SKILL.md document as the learned artifact ( Li et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) . Among self-evolution methods, SkillOpt and SkillAudit primarily revise instruction documents, whereas CoEvoSkills and SkillEvolver support executable multi-file packages ( Yang et al., 2026 ; Gao et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ; Zhang et al., 2026a ) .
paragraphs.zh: 现有研究涵盖三种场景：评估固定技能的下游效用、从任务经验或源语料库中生成可重用的技能，以及通过反馈优化现有技能。 固定技能基准测试在不修改技能包的情况下对其进行评估，而代表性技能生成和持续学习基准测试通常使用 SKILL.md 文档作为学习成果（Li et al., 2026；Han et al., 2026；Zhong et al., 2026；Zhou et al., 2026）。 在自我演化方法中，SkillOpt 和 SkillAudit 主要修改指令文档，而 CoEvoSkills 和 SkillEvolver 则支持可执行的跨文件技能包（Yang et al., 2026；Gao et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b；Zhang et al., 2026a）。

paragraphs.en: Despite this progress, the self-evolution of existing executable skill packages remains underexplored in current benchmarks, particularly the revision of scripts and their consistency with documentation. These components can fail independently: a documented command may pass an unsupported option to an otherwise correct script, while a script may mishandle an option that is correctly documented. Task success and broader skill-quality assessments do not, by themselves, distinguish documentation repair from script repair, and aggregate results can obscure regressions in packages that were already correct ( Li et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ; Zhang et al., 2026b ) . Addressing these gaps requires a benchmark that evaluates revisions for fault repair, documentation–script consistency, and preservation of correct behavior across diverse executable packages.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管取得了这些进展，现有可执行技能包的自我演化在当前的基准测试中仍未被充分探索，尤其是脚本的修订及其与文档的一致性。 这些组件可能独立失效：一个有文档说明的命令可能会向原本正确的脚本传递一个不受支持的选择项，而一个脚本也可能错误处理一个有正确文档说明的选择项。 任务成功和更广泛的技能质量评估本身无法区分文档修复与脚本修复，且汇总结果可能会掩盖那些原本已正确的技能包中出现的性能退化（Li et al., 2026；Zhong et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2026；Zhang et al., 2026b）。 要解决这些不足，需要一个能够评估故障修复修订、文档与脚本一致性，以及在多样化可执行技能包中保持正确行为的基准测试。

paragraphs.en: Across four LLMs, methods that revise both documentation and scripts can repair script faults but do not consistently outperform Markdown-only revision on documentation repair or clean-package preservation. To better coordinate repair and preservation, we introduce AST-Guided Skill Revision as an additional stage for existing revision methods. It analyzes the original package and an initial revision, links maintenance requirements to abstract syntax tree (AST) nodes, and uses calling relationships to provide context for targeted edits. Script edits are restricted to selected nodes and guided by preservation constraints derived from requirements assessed as satisfied. The documentation is then aligned with the maintenance request and revised implementation. Averaged across the four models, this stage increases repair success on faulty packages from 54.8% to 76.7% for Raw Package and from 48.8% to 76.5% for our CoEvoSkills adaptation. The proportions of tasks solved in all three runs increase by 20.8 and 31.5 percentage points, respectively, and both augmented methods improve clean-package preservation relative to their corresponding baselines.

sents.en: Script edits are restricted to selected nodes and guided by preservation constraints derived from requirements assessed as satisfied.
sents.zh: 脚本编辑仅限于选定的节点，并由根据已满足需求评估出的保留约束进行引导。

sents.en: The documentation is then aligned with the maintenance request and revised implementation.
sents.zh: 随后，文档会与维护请求及修订后的实现内容进行对齐。

sents.en: Averaged across the four models, this stage increases repair success on faulty packages from 54.8% to 76.7% for Raw Package and from 48.8% to 76.5% for our CoEvoSkills adaptation.
sents.zh: 在四种模型的平均结果中，这一阶段将故障包的修复成功率从“原始包”的 54.8% 提升至 76.7%，从我们的 CoEvoSkills 适配版本的 48.8% 提升至 76.5%。

sents.en: The proportions of tasks solved in all three runs increase by 20.8 and 31.5 percentage points, respectively, and both augmented methods improve clean-package preservation relative to their corresponding baselines.
sents.zh: 在所有三次运行中，任务解决的比例分别提升了 20.8 和 31.5 个百分点，且两种增强方法相较于其对应的基线方法都改善了对干净包的保留能力。

paragraphs.en: 1. A benchmark for executable skill self-evolution. We introduce SkillScriptBench , a 350-task benchmark that treats existing Agent Skill packages as the unit of evolution, covering documentation, scripts, and their consistency through repository-sourced tasks and matched clean and faulty states.
paragraphs.zh: 1. 一个用于可执行技能自我演化的基准。 我们提出了 SkillScriptBench，这是一个包含 350 个任务的基准测试，它将现有的智能体技能包视为演化的基本单位，涵盖文档、脚本以及通过仓库来源的任务和匹配的干净与错误状态来检验其一致性。

sents.en: A benchmark for executable skill self-evolution.
sents.zh: 一个用于可执行技能自我演化的基准。

sents.en: We introduce SkillScriptBench , a 350-task benchmark that treats existing Agent Skill packages as the unit of evolution, covering documentation, scripts, and their consistency through repository-sourced tasks and matched clean and faulty states.
sents.zh: 我们提出了 SkillScriptBench，这是一个包含 350 个任务的基准测试，它将现有的智能体技能包视为演化的基本单位，涵盖文档、脚本以及通过仓库来源的任务和匹配的干净与错误状态来检验其一致性。

paragraphs.en: 2. Empirical findings on repair and preservation. Across four LLMs, we show that full-package revision supports script repair but does not consistently improve documentation repair or clean-package preservation over Markdown-only revision.
paragraphs.zh: 2. 关于修复与保留的经验性发现。 通过对四种大型语言模型的研究，我们发现完整包修订有助于脚本修复，但在文档修复或干净包保留方面，相比仅使用 Markdown 的修订方法，效果并不始终更优。

sents.en: Empirical findings on repair and preservation.
sents.zh: 关于修复与保留的经验性发现。

sents.en: Across four LLMs, we show that full-package revision supports script repair but does not consistently improve documentation repair or clean-package preservation over Markdown-only revision.

paragraphs.en: 3. A structure-guided self-evolution method. AST-Guided Skill Revision combines targeted script edits, preservation constraints, and documentation alignment, improving repair and preservation when applied to Raw Package and adapted CoEvoSkills outputs.
paragraphs.zh: 3. 一种结构引导的自演化方法。 AST-引导的技能修订结合了目标脚本编辑、保留约束和文档对齐，在应用于原始包和适配的 CoEvoSkills 输出时，能够提升修复与保留效果。

paragraphs.en: SkillScriptBench evaluates how Agent Skills revise their Markdown instructions and executable scripts to satisfy maintenance requests, using 350 tasks across two complementary tracks. In-the-Wild Repair covers diverse public packages and maintenance requirements. Controlled Repair uses matched clean and faulty package states to assess documentation repair, script repair, joint repair, and preservation of correct behavior. Table 1 compares the package-maintenance coverage of SkillScriptBench and representative Agent Skill benchmarks ( Li et al., 2026 ; Han et al., 2026 ; Zhong et al., 2026 ; Zhou et al., 2026 ) .

Each task pairs the faulty package with a maintenance request describing the expected behavior or a failure symptom. Executable checks distinguish the faulty version from a correct reference implementation. Tasks from the same package target different maintenance requirements.

paragraphs.en: This track tests whether methods repair faulty documentation and scripts while preserving correct ones. For each of 50 repository-derived packages, we keep the maintenance request fixed and construct four states: Clean without faults, Doc with documentation faults only, Script with script faults only, and Joint with both. The 200 tasks support within-package comparisons.
paragraphs.zh: 该测试用例旨在检验相关方法能否在修复有缺陷的文档和脚本的同时，保留正确的部分。 对于每个从仓库中获取的 50 个包，我们保持维护请求不变，并构建四种状态：Clean（无故障）、Doc（仅存在文档故障）、Script（仅存在脚本故障）以及 Joint（同时存在文档和脚本故障）。 这 200 项任务支持包内比较。

paragraphs.en: AST-Guided Skill Revision coordinates Markdown–script repair by linking maintenance requirements to executable structure. We assess documentation and implementation separately against the same request, identifying discrepancies to repair and correct behavior to preserve. paragraphs.en: The LLM interprets the behavior required by q q and identifies related claims in Markdown. It links these requirements and claims to their applicability conditions, supporting passages, and relevant implementation sites. Language-native AST/CST analysis binds the proposed sites to uniquely matched syntax nodes. Caller–helper relationships connect these nodes to related implementation sites, providing context for requirements that span function boundaries.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型会解读 q q 所要求的行为，并识别 Markdown 中的相关主张。 它会将这些要求和主张与其适用条件、支持性段落以及相关的实现位置关联起来。 基于母语的语言 AST/CST 分析会将提议的实现位置与唯一匹配的语法节点绑定。 调用者–辅助者关系将这些节点与相关的实现位置连接起来，为跨越函数边界的 yêu cầu 提供上下文。

paragraphs.en: For each grounded requirement, the LLM assesses the implementation and documentation separately under its applicability conditions. Related callers and helpers provide supporting context without necessarily becoming edit targets. We assess both S S and S ~ \widetilde{S} , retaining requirement-linked symbols and call context from S S when the initial revision removes them. Together, these assessments and structural bindings form the revision feedback ℛ = G ⁡ ( q , S , S ~ ) \mathcal{R}=G(q,S,\widetilde{S}) supplied to the script editor.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个具体化的需求，大型语言模型会分别评估其适用性条件下实现部分和文档部分的符合情况。 我们将评估出的实现差异映射到可编辑的已解决语法节点上，从而形成修复目标，这些目标界定了后续脚本修改的范围。 被评估为满足需求的代码行为会提供保留约束，包括在相应文档需要修正时的处理规则。 相关的调用者和辅助函数会提供支持性上下文，但未必成为修改目标。 我们同时评估 S S 和 S ~ \widetilde{S}，并在初始修订移除了与需求相关的符号及调用上下文时予以保留。 这些评估结果与结构绑定共同构成了修订反馈 ℛ = G ⁡ ( q , S , S ~ ) \mathcal{R}=G(q,S,\widetilde{S})，并将其提供给脚本编辑器。

paragraphs.en: The revision model uses the repair targets, caller–helper context, and preservation constraints in ℛ \mathcal{R} to generate node-level script replacements for each package version. Edits leave source text outside the selected spans unchanged and are accepted only if the resulting scripts pass syntax and applicable interface-preservation checks. Assembly uses S ~ \widetilde{S} as its base, retaining its validated edits and incorporating compatible edits from S S through unique source matching. The model then aligns documented invocations and operational instructions with the maintenance request q q and the resulting scripts, correcting identified inconsistencies through localized Markdown edits supported by script evidence. Appendices A.3 and A.4 detail the feedback representation, edit validation, and package assembly rules.

paragraphs.en: We adapt CoEvoSkills ( Zhang et al., 2026b ) to maintenance-request-driven revision of executable Skill packages. An independent surrogate verifier assesses the package against the request and produces requirement-linked checks and a diagnosis. A failure reported by the verifier or its executed checks triggers the generator to revise SKILL.md and scripts using the diagnosis and check results. To obtain CoEvoSkills + AST, we use the returned package as the initial revision S ~ \widetilde{S} and apply AST-Guided Skill Revision to ( q , S , S ~ ) (q,S,\widetilde{S}) .
paragraphs.zh: 我们将 CoEvoSkills（Zhang 等人，2026b）应用于由维护请求驱动的 executable Skill 包修订。 一个独立的代理验证器根据请求对包进行评估，并生成与需求相关的检查项和诊断结果。 验证器或其执行检查报告的任何故障都会触发生成器，利用诊断结果和检查结果修订 SKILL.md 和脚本。 为了获得 CoEvoSkills + AST，我们将返回的包用作初始修订版本 S ~ \widetilde{S}，并对 (q, S, S ~)（q,S,\widetilde{S}）应用 AST 引导的 Skill 修订。

paragraphs.en: Full-package baselines achieve broader repair coverage, but documentation repair remains a weakness. Averaged across four backbones, Raw Package and CoEvoSkills achieve Overall Avg scores of 54.8% and 48.8%, respectively. Both baselines repair script faults, joint faults, and In-the-Wild cases. However, their documentation-repair Avg scores are 27.3% and 23.2%, respectively, compared with 27.0% for Markdown-only.

paragraphs.en: AST-guided revision improves repair success across all four backbones. paragraphs.en: We analyze package revision along two dimensions: the balance between fault correction and behavior preservation, and the variation in revision gains across task characteristics.

paragraphs.en: Broader repair coverage does not imply better preservation of correct behavior. paragraphs.en: AST-guided revision improves fault correction and behavior preservation together. Applied to Raw Package on documentation-fault tasks, it changes 42.8% of task/run pairs from failure to success, whereas only 0.8% change from success to failure. Corrections also outnumber regressions on script and joint faults for both generators. On Clean tasks, mean Hit 3 \mathrm{Hit}^{3} rises from 85.5% to 96.5% for Raw Package and from 93.0% to 96.5% for CoEvoSkills, indicating more consistent preservation across all three runs.

paragraphs.en: Structure-aware program repair uses program representations to guide code changes. Astor applies AST-level transformations to Java programs, Getafix learns hierarchical fix patterns from past edits, and TBar applies repair templates at localized fault sites ( Martinez and Monperrus, 2016 ; Bader et al., 2019 ; Liu et al., 2019 ) . LLM-based approaches such as Agentless organize repository repair into localization, patch generation, and validation ( Xia et al., 2024 ) . Repository-level benchmarks such as SWE-bench evaluate patches against real issue descriptions and executable tests ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) . Complementary work updates natural-language comments to reflect changes in the associated code ( Panthaplackel et al., 2020 ) . These settings do not explicitly address joint revision of Markdown instructions and executable scripts to restore their consistency.
paragraphs.zh: 结构感知程序修复利用程序表示来指导代码变更。 Astor 对 Java 程序应用 AST 级别的转换，Getafix 从过往的编辑中学习分层修复模式，而 TBar 则在局部故障位置应用修复模板（Martinez 和 Monperrus，2016；Bader 等，2019；Liu 等，2019）。 基于 LLM 的方法（如 Agentless）将仓库修复组织为定位、补丁生成和验证三个阶段（Xia 等，2024）。 SWE-bench 这类仓库级基准测试通过真实问题描述和可执行测试来评估补丁（Jimenez 等，2024）。 相关补充工作会更新自然语言注释，以反映关联代码中的变更（Panthaplackel 等，2020）。 这些设置并未明确解决 Markdown 说明与可执行脚本的联合修订问题，以恢复二者的一致性。

paragraphs.en: We introduced SkillScriptBench , a 350-task benchmark for self-evolution of executable Agent Skill packages. It combines In-the-Wild Repair, built from a scan of over 35,000 public Skill roots, with Controlled Repair across matched clean, documentation-fault, script-fault, and joint-fault states. Across four LLM backbones, full-package baselines broaden repair coverage but do not consistently outperform Markdown-only revision in documentation repair or clean-package preservation. We proposed AST-Guided Skill Revision to coordinate Markdown and script revisions through requirement-grounded structural feedback. Applied to Raw Package and CoEvoSkills, it improves both repair and preservation while increasing mean all-three-run success ( Hit 3 \mathrm{Hit}^{3} ) across all four artifact states. Evaluation of executable Skill evolution should distinguish fault repair from preservation of correct package behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了 SkillScriptBench，这是一个包含 350 项任务的基准测试，用于评估可执行智能体技能包的自我演化能力。 它将“野外修复”（基于对超过 35,000 个公开技能根目录的扫描）与“受控修复”相结合，后者覆盖了匹配的干净状态、文档故障状态、脚本故障状态以及联合故障状态。 在四种 LLM 基础模型中，全包基线方法虽然扩展了修复覆盖范围，但在文档修复或干净包保留方面，并未始终优于仅使用 Markdown 的修订方法。 我们提出了“AST 引导技能修订”方法，通过基于需求的结构反馈来协调 Markdown 和脚本的修订过程。 该方法应用于 Raw Package 和 CoEvoSkills 后，在提升修复与保留效果的同时，也提高了所有四种工件状态下三次运行全部成功的平均成功率（Hit 3 \mathrm{Hit}^{3}）。 对可执行技能演化的评估应能区分故障修复与正确包行为的保留。

paragraphs.en: The LLM assesses each requirement separately in S S and S ~ \widetilde{S} . For code, REPAIR identifies an implementation discrepancy, SATISFIED identifies behavior that meets the requirement, and UNCERTAIN records an inconclusive assessment. Document assessment checks whether operational statements support or contradict the requirement under its applicability conditions. A normative contradiction under the same or overlapping conditions yields CONTRADICTED . Supporting evidence under the same conditions, review of the full document, and an unambiguous assessment yield SATISFIED . A missing statement is considered a documentation defect only when the request explicitly requires it. Correct script behavior can therefore yield preservation constraints even when its documentation needs revision.
paragraphs.zh: LLM 在 S、S 和 S ~ \widetilde{S} 中分别评估每个需求。 对于代码，REPAIR 会识别实现差异，SATISFIED 会识别满足需求的运行行为，而 UNCERTAIN 则记录无法得出明确结论的评估结果。 文档评估会检查操作陈述在其适用性条件下是否支持或违背该需求。 在相同或重叠的条件下出现规范性矛盾时，结果会标记为 CONTRADICTED。 在相同条件下存在支持证据、已审查完整文档且评估结果明确无误时，结果会标记为 SATISFIED。 只有当请求明确要求时，缺失的陈述才会被视为文档缺陷。 因此，即使脚本的文档需要修订，其正确的运行行为也可能产生保留约束。

paragraphs.en: A script target requires a high-confidence requirement, a REPAIR code assessment for its snapshot, and a uniquely resolved EDIT binding to an editable node. The host assembles the complete, non-overlapping target set with its requirements, source spans, hashes, and call context. High-confidence requirements with a SATISFIED code assessment supply preservation constraints; UNCERTAIN assessments supply neither edit permissions nor preservation constraints for that snapshot. CONTEXT bindings provide supporting structure without authorizing edits. Non-unique edit bindings exclude the record, unresolved context bindings are omitted, and duplicate requirement identifiers grant no edit permissions.
paragraphs.zh: 一个脚本目标需要高置信度的要求、对其快照的 REPAIR 代码评估，以及对可编辑节点的唯一解析的 EDIT 绑定。 主机结合其要求、源片段、哈希和调用上下文，组装出完整且不重叠的目标集合。 具有 SATISFIED 代码评估的高置信度要求会提供保留约束；而 UNCERTAIN 评估则既不提供编辑权限，也不为该快照提供保留约束。 CONTEXT 绑定提供支撑结构，但不会授权进行编辑。 非唯一的编辑绑定会排除该记录，未解析的上下文绑定会被省略，重复的要求标识符则不会授予任何编辑权限。

paragraphs.en: For each source snapshot, the editor either abstains or returns exactly one replacement for every admitted target. Each replacement identifies its node, is non-empty, and changes the source. Source hashes bind the response to its input snapshot. Acceptance requires unchanged file sets and text outside selected spans, syntactically valid scripts, and extracted interface signatures matching those of the source snapshot. Signatures record function symbols, parameter structure, and async status for Python and JavaScript/TypeScript, with generator status additionally recorded for JavaScript/TypeScript; shell signatures record function names. Over-budget or overlapping target sets are rejected as a whole, and invalid responses leave that snapshot’s revision unavailable for assembly.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个源快照，编辑器要么不作回应，要么为每个被接受的目标返回且仅返回一个替换项。 每个替换项都标识其节点、非空，并且会修改源内容。 源哈希将响应与其输入快照绑定。 接受条件要求文件集和所选范围外的文本保持不变、脚本在语法上有效，以及提取的接口签名与源快照的签名相匹配。 签名记录了 Python 和 JavaScript/TypeScript 的函数符号、参数结构和异步状态，其中 JavaScript/TypeScript 还会额外记录生成器状态；Shell 签名则记录函数名称。 超出预算或存在重叠的目标集将整体被拒绝，而无效的响应会导致该快照的修订版本无法用于组装。

paragraphs.en: After script assembly, the LLM aligns SKILL.md with q q and the assembled implementation, including when no script edits were made. Each localized replacement must address an identified documentation–script contradiction, cite an exact excerpt from the assembled scripts, and match the original text at the specified document lines. Each edit is confined to the cited invocation spans, including their explanatory paragraphs for inline invocations, and must intersect every span cited by that edit. Replacements must be non-empty and change the original content. Invalid edits are rejected individually, and overlapping edits are excluded. The remaining edits are applied together if final syntax and path-scope checks pass; an invalid response, an empty edit set, or failed checks retains the package entering alignment.
paragraphs.zh: 脚本组装后，LLM 会将 SKILL.md 与 q q 以及已组装的实现进行对齐，即使没有对脚本进行任何编辑。 每个本地化替换都必须解决已识别的文档与脚本之间的矛盾，引用组装后的脚本中的确切片段，并在指定的文档行中与原文本匹配。 每次编辑都仅限于所引用的调用范围，包括内联调用的解释性段落，并且必须与该编辑所引用的所有范围相交。 替换内容必须非空，且必须改变原始内容。 无效的编辑将被单独拒绝，重叠的编辑则会被排除。 如果最终的语法和路径作用域检查通过，则剩余编辑将一并应用；若出现无效响应、编辑集为空或检查失败，则包将保持进入对齐状态。

paragraphs.en: The CoEvoSkills adapter uses a separate surrogate verifier to assess the visible package against the maintenance request. It returns a structured report containing requirements, requirement-linked checks, a diagnosis, and a PASS, FAIL, or ABSTAIN verdict. The proposed checks cover file presence or absence, required or forbidden text, and script syntax. They are executed programmatically. Each run uses one surrogate-verification call. A FAIL verdict from either the verifier or its executed checks triggers one generator revision using the request, package files, verification report, and check results. The run then terminates. If neither verdict is FAIL, the input package is retained. The surrogate verifier and generator use the settings in Table 13 .
paragraphs.zh: CoEvoSkills 适配器使用一个独立的代理验证器，将可见的包与维护请求进行比对评估。 它会返回一份结构化报告，其中包含需求、与需求相关的检查项、诊断结果以及通过（PASS）、失败（FAIL）或弃权（ABSTAIN）的判断结论。 所提议的检查项涵盖文件是否存在、是否包含指定文本以及脚本语法等问题。 这些检查项会通过程序执行。 每次运行都会使用一次代理验证调用。 如果验证器或其执行结果中的任何一项判断为失败（FAIL），则会触发一次生成器修订，该修订会使用请求、包文件、验证报告及检查结果，随后运行终止。 如果两项判断均非失败（FAIL），则保留输入包。 代理验证器和生成器使用表 13 中的设置。

paragraphs.en: We examine the contributions of structural feedback and caller–helper context to coordinated package revision. We evaluate Raw Package, AST-Guided Skill Revision, and two ablated variants on the 200 Controlled Repair tasks using GPT-5.6-Sol, with three runs per task. Table 18 summarizes the revision components. Both ablated variants retain Markdown alignment. w/o Structural Feedback replaces structural feedback and AST-node editing with source-text diagnosis and exact-text editing. w/o Call Context retains AST-grounded targets, node-level editing, and interface checks, but removes extracted caller–helper context from the editor input. The two variants start from identical Raw Package outputs for each task and run and use the settings in Table 13 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究了结构反馈和调用者-辅助者上下文对协调软件包修订的贡献。 我们使用 GPT-5.6-Sol，在 200 个受控修复任务上评估了原始软件包、AST 引导技能修订以及两种删减变体，每个任务运行三次。 表 18 总结了修订的各个组成部分。 两种删减变体都保留了 Markdown 对齐功能。w/o Structural Feedback 用源文本诊断和精确文本编辑取代了结构反馈和 AST 节点编辑。w/o Call Context 保留了基于 AST 的目标、节点级编辑和接口检查，但移除了从编辑器输入中提取的调用者-辅助者上下文。 对于每个任务和每次运行，这两种变体都从相同的原始软件包输出开始，并使用表 13 中的设置。

sents.zh: 我们研究了结构反馈和调用者-辅助者上下文对协调软件包修订的贡献。

paragraphs.en: To compare language and repair scope, we retain categories represented in both groups and recompute each group’s Avg with equal category weights. The observed and adjusted estimates use the same tasks. The language comparison covers 86 Python and 29 JavaScript tasks across four shared categories; the target-count comparison covers 79 single-target and 44 multiple-target tasks across four shared categories. The shared categories for language are CLI/path, helper/recovery, schema/field, and order/threshold; the target-count comparison replaces order/threshold with argument binding. Equal weighting changes the Python–JavaScript gap from 12.3 to 5.1 points for Raw Package and from 13.3 to 16.9 points for CoEvoSkills; the corresponding +AST gaps are − 8.1 -8.1 and 5.7 points. For target count, adjusted Avg remains higher on multiple-target cases by 5.2 points for Raw Package + AST and 11.7 points for CoEvoSkills + AST. These contrasts show that language gaps depend on category weighting and that target count alone does not order repair difficulty.
paragraphs.zh: 为了比较语言差异和修复范围，我们保留两个组中都存在的类别，并以相等的类别权重重新计算每个组的平均值。 观察到的估计值和调整后的估计值使用了相同的任务。 语言比较涵盖了四个共享类别中的 86 个 Python 任务和 29 个 JavaScript 任务；目标数量比较则涵盖了四个共享类别中的 79 个单目标任务和 44 个多目标任务。 语言比较的共享类别为 CLI/路径、辅助/恢复、模式/字段以及顺序/阈值；目标数量比较则将顺序/阈值替换为参数绑定。 采用相等权重后，原始包（Raw Package）的 Python–JavaScript 差距从 12.3 点变为 5.1 点，CoEvoSkills 的差距则从 13.3 点变为 16.9 点；对应的 +AST 差距分别为 −8.1、−8.1 和 5.7 点。 对于目标数量，调整后的平均值在多目标情况下仍然更高：原始包（Raw Package）+ AST 的差距为 5.2 点，CoEvoSkills + AST 的差距为 11.7 点。 这些对比表明，语言差异取决于类别权重，而仅凭目标数量无法确定修复难度的顺序。

paragraphs.en: The canonical SKILL.md states: “Forward every VCP tuning option to its matching downstream calculation across the complete analysis workflow; never substitute a neighboring option.” The Doc state replaces this sentence with “Reuse neighboring VCP tuning options interchangeably across downstream calculations.” The Script state changes six keyword-argument values in analyze_stock (Table 25 ), leaving the called calculators unchanged. Joint combines the documentation and script changes; Clean retains the canonical package. Methods receive one package state and the shared request.

paragraphs.en: Propose locations using exact source_id, AST/CST node_type, exact node quote and enclosing symbol (empty string if unknown). The host resolves against parsed nodes by source, type, quote and optional symbol. Never count source lines yourself. Set line_hint to 0 unless you copy a host-displayed source line number. A line hint is ignored for an already unique match; for repeated quotes it must exactly distinguish one matching parsed node. The host never shifts lines or picks the nearest node. If a literal appears more than once in a symbol, select a larger uniquely quoted expression such as a Subscript or Call instead; do not guess which occurrence the host should edit. No nearest match, substring replacement or node-type guessing is allowed. Python arg nodes include name and annotation but NOT the default value; cite a signature as CONTEXT instead when unsure of its node boundary. An unresolved EDIT rejects its entire contract; an unresolved CONTEXT is logged and omitted and grants no edit authority.

sents.zh: 旧片段和替换内容必须各自覆盖正在更改的完整语法结构（例如整个函数、分支、映射项或命令块），因此不能留下孤立的标题、分支、分隔符或缩进。

sents.en: For create_file use an empty expected_file_sha256 and empty observed_source.
sents.zh: 对于 create_file，使用空的 expected_file_sha256 和空的 observed_source。

paragraphs.en: Hidden tests, labels, gold code, oracle behavior, benchmark outcomes, and task-verifier feedback remain unavailable.
paragraphs.zh: 隐藏测试、标签、参考代码、神谕行为、基准结果以及任务验证器反馈仍然不可用。

paragraphs.en: The In-the-Wild track is predominantly Python, and both tracks use constructed faults to evaluate package maintenance. Broader language coverage and tasks derived from naturally occurring failures would help assess generalization to the wider Skill ecosystem. Our evaluation measures package-level correctness and documentation–script consistency; reliability in long-horizon downstream Agent workflows remains to be evaluated.
paragraphs.zh: “野外环境”赛道主要使用 Python，且两个赛道都通过构造的故障来评估包维护能力。 更广泛的编程语言覆盖以及源自自然发生的故障的任务，将有助于评估模型在更广泛的 Skill 生态系统中的泛化能力。 我们的评估测量了包级别的正确性以及文档与脚本之间的一致性；而在长期下游智能体工作流程中的可靠性仍有待进一步评估。
